name: Other ALK TKIs (brigatinib / lorlatinib / crizotinib) for ALK-rearranged NSCLC

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: ALK-TKI gate: requires an ALK rearrangement (ALK gene fusion). The agents modeled here are additional ALK-TKI options for the same gate: brigatinib and lorlatinib (later-generation, first-line options) and crizotinib (first-generation; largely superseded by alectinib/brigatinib/lorlatinib but still a listed option). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), NSCLC v7.2026, Therapy for Actionable Molecular Markers (ALK Gene Fusion).

histology: non-small cell lung cancer (predominantly adenocarcinoma; ALK rearrangements are most common in nonsquamous histology)
supportiveCare: Continuous oral dosing until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
Brigatinib: 7-day lead-in at 90 mg/day before escalating to 180 mg/day; monitor for early-onset pulmonary events.
Lorlatinib: monitor lipids (hypercholesterolemia/hypertriglyceridemia), CNS/mood effects, and weight per labeling.
Crizotinib: monitor for hepatotoxicity, QTc prolongation, visual disturbance, and pneumonitis.

doseModificationRules.condition: brigatinib early pulmonary event, or grade 3 or higher toxicity / ILD on any agent
doseModificationRules.text: Hold, reduce, or discontinue per labeling and clinical review; for brigatinib use the 90 mg/day 7-day lead-in and evaluate any early pulmonary symptoms; permanently discontinue for confirmed ILD/pneumonitis.

drugs.name: Brigatinib
drugs.notes: ALTERNATIVE, MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE ALK-TKI monotherapy: choose ONE agent in this file, not a combination. Source: DeVita 12th ed. line 70559 (ALTA-1L, brigatinib 180 mg per day). Brigatinib 180 mg PO once daily continuous, WITH A 7-DAY LEAD-IN at 90 mg per day (source-stated). dosePerUnit reflects the maintenance dose (180 mg); the 90 mg lead-in for days 1 to 7 is described in notes/dose-modification, not separately modeled. cycles null (until progression).

provenance.locator: line 70557 to 70559 (ALTA-1L: brigatinib 180 mg per day with a 7-day lead-in of 90 mg per day)

drugs.name: Lorlatinib
drugs.notes: ALTERNATIVE, MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE ALK-TKI monotherapy: choose ONE agent in this file, not a combination. Source: DeVita 12th ed. line 70564 (CROWN, lorlatinib 100 mg per day). Lorlatinib 100 mg PO once daily continuous (days 1 to 28, cycles null).

provenance.locator: line 70564 (CROWN: lorlatinib 100 mg per day, first-line ALK-positive NSCLC)

drugs.name: Crizotinib
drugs.notes: ALTERNATIVE, MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE ALK-TKI monotherapy: choose ONE agent in this file, not a combination. Source: DeVita 12th ed. line 70544 to 70545 (ALEX comparator, crizotinib 250 mg twice daily). Crizotinib 250 mg PO TWICE DAILY (BID); dosePerUnit is the per-dose amount (250 mg), given twice daily (total 500 mg/day). Earlier-generation ALK TKI, generally superseded by alectinib/brigatinib/lorlatinib. cycles null (until progression). Ceritinib is also a listed ALK-fusion option in the corpus (DeVita lines 70565 to 70567) but NO ceritinib mg dose is printed and would require VERIFY if substituted.

provenance.locator: line 70544 to 70545 (ALEX: crizotinib 250 mg twice daily, comparator arm)
